# `kernel/protocol/ParticleRealmsProtocol.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/protocol/ParticleRealmsProtocol.js`

ParticleRealmsProtocol.js — the MCP-inspired protocol facade tying together this app's capability/tool/resource/prompt/root/elicitation/sampling registries. Exposed as kernel.protocol; wrapped by syscalls.protocol. An app calls declare(manifest) once (validated against os.AppAICapabilityManifest in OsSchemas.js) to register its tool/resource/ prompt/root metadata for AI discovery. Declaring metadata here is always advisory/self-descriptive — it never grants authority; actual tool execution still goes through ToolRouter's firewall (Phase 3) and actual resource reads still go through ResourceRegistry -> UntrustedBoundary.

## Classes

### `class ParticleRealmsProtocol`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(kernel)` |  |
| `declare` | `declare(manifest)` | An app declares its full AI capability manifest in one call. Tools must already be registered with kernel.toolDriver (undeclared/unknown tools are skipped with a warning, never throw — a manifest typo shouldn't crash app boot). |
| `undeclareApp` | `undeclareApp(appId, expectedToken = null)` |  |

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```
